case_title: FAZARALI & ORS. v. STATE OF ASSAM
trial_court_outcome: Convicted under s.302 r/w s.149 and sentenced to life imprisonment
offence_finally_established: Murder under s.302 r/w s.149 IPC
neutral_facts: The accused, along with others, attacked the complainant, his father, his brother, and his mother-in-law in the early morning. The accused were armed with various weapons and inflicted injuries on the victims. The injured individuals were not allowed to be taken to the hospital for approximately three hours, despite requests from neighbors and others present at the scene. The victims were eventually taken to the hospital, where the complainant's brother died. The prosecution presented evidence including eyewitness accounts, medical reports, and statements from witnesses. The trial court convicted the accused under Section 302 read with Section 149 of the IPC, and the High Court upheld this decision.
